column1: # One line per helpfile column rather than one per timestep, which is
# the transpose of the helpfile itself. A quantity that moves then shows
# up as a single changed line in a diff, naming itself, instead of
# changing every row of the file.
# A column holding one value for the whole run is written as "const" and
# that value; a column that varies is written as "series" and one value
# per row. Most of the helpfile is constant over any given run, so
# storing those once is most of the difference in file size.
